C1387.title: Mirai Botnet DDoS Attack on DNS Provider Dyn Causes Major Internet Outage
C1387.summary: The Mirai botnet became active in August 2016 and reached an infection peak in September, affecting services such as Krebs on Security, OVH, and Dyn. The attack used large numbers of infected IoT devices such as home routers and cameras to launch large-scale DDoS attacks, causing major internet service disruptions. If the October 21, 2016 Dyn attack and outages at Twitter, Netflix, Reddit, and others are included, sources that explicitly document those facts should be added.
